description: Email address verification for AI agents and lead-qualification pipelines: syntax check, disposable-domain detection, role-account (info@, support@) detection, free-provider flag, domain typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com) and DNS MX/A validation via DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns verdict valid, risky, invalid or unknown with a 0-100 score. No SMTP probing, so mailbox existence is not confirmed.
name: email_check
